title: Unique descent of natural isomorphisms through raw scalar localization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, C an R-linear preadditive triangulated category with zero object and Z-shifts linear and additive, and p:R. Let Q:C to ScalarLocalization R C p be raw localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. For every category A and functors F,G:ScalarLocalization R C p to A, every natural isomorphism e:Q then F to Q then G has a unique natural isomorphism d:F to G with d.hom.app(Q K)=e.hom.app K for every K:C. No target additivity or linearity is required.

source.place: Stacks 04VB, 05R2: categorical localization universal property; application to the actual raw scalar localization

proof.text: Use the proved identification with categorical Rationalization from SemilinearScalarLocalization to make Q a localization at p-power multiples of identities. Apply fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft to Q: precomposition on functor categories is fully faithful. Take the preimageIso of e. Its map_preimage equation evaluated on K gives the required component equation.

For any other d satisfying the component equations, extensionality gives equality of the precomposed natural transformations. Faithfulness then gives equality of the original hom natural transformations, and Iso.ext gives equality of the natural isomorphisms.
